name: A crossing recorded on one signature
tactic: Record a syndication event — a claim that history crossed from another chain — with only one custodian's signature instead of the quorum, hoping it reads as routine bookkeeping rather than the assertion it actually is.

response.fail: {{ledger}} accepted a syndication on one signature. This must never happen — recording what another chain contains is exactly as consequential as amending the rules, and is gated the same way.

text: A syndication event is quorum-gated like amend and checkpoint, not merely signed like a note, because it changes what this ledger asserts about a chain it cannot itself verify. That assertion should never rest on one custodian's word.
